about.title: About NgDigest
about.lead: NgDigest is an Angular tech watch platform that aggregates the best articles, tutorials and announcements from the community every week.
about.howItWorks.title: How does it work?
about.howItWorks.text: NgDigest uses SerpAPI to automatically collect the most relevant content published on trusted Angular websites. Articles are filtered by language (French and English) and sorted by publication date.
